findings.summary: Now that read_rows returns a one-shot generator, the any() check at line 25 consumes rows up to and including the first high-severity row, so the loop at line 28 skips them. This drops the first high event from summary.high and undercounts total and by_actor, and it can wrongly report a quiet day.

judge.reason: Describes any() consuming the one-shot generator through the first high row so the later loop misses it, the same defect as b1.

findings.label: hit
